title: CB8-H: rolling windowed taker prints [h, h + 26 h] for snapshot market-days >= 30 h old (<= 5 pages; capped day unavailable; wallets hashed; full prints for c >= 0.5 market-days, top-5-holder prints elsewhere) and capture marks [h, h + 30 h]
expected_value: exits, controls and marks for CH70
data: complete captures on the host (touch of stored markets only, read within retention)
notes: H v2 (2026-10-17): PINS the v4 rules (H-v4 amendment) (seals/cb8_holders_rules_v4.json, rules_sha256 2aca9bdcc94490e218fb0fd162cf322e3c1b19ba0ee2b71d3af71f628d14a72f) and requires the v3 smoke PASS (q0160c) incl. criterion (g) paging (holders_smoke_v3.json); depends on q0160c. Concentration c uses the stored oi_tf (OI at the day's frame time t_f, not at h). CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-H Collection. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_holders.holders_prints), still a DRAFT until promoted. Promote together with q0162 (same smoke gate; it simply idles until the first snapshot day is old enough). Idle rhythm as q0162: exit 75 normally, a clean exit 0 (idle_heartbeat) at least every 10 h so the queue's 48-consecutive-tempfail limit never fires. Processes the oldest snapshot day whose markets are all >= --lag-h 30 old (DEVIATION from the design's 28 h: marks need captures through h + 30 h, and an exit at h + 24 h with a +2 h mark and a 2.5-h capture window needs h + 28.5 h); prints [h, h + 26 h] per market (<= 5 pages of 1,000; a capped market-day is 'capped', unavailable, nothing stored; a failed request is retried in later chunks and after 3 attempts recorded as 'failed', counted apart from no-data); storage rule: all prints of market-days with c >= 0.5 on either token, else prints by top-5 holders of either token; then the capture marks (YES best bid/ask of stored markets at every complete capture in [h, h + 30 h] while the 8-day capture retention holds; unreadable captures counted). Completes (holders_prints_complete) when q0162 is complete and every snapshot day is processed. Output cap 0.12 GB (written estimate: about 0.9 MB a day = about 27k stored print rows at about 28 B plus marks and summaries, x 63 days = about 57 MB, doubled for estimate error), sticky disk_budget end state (exit 4). No target computed; no raw wallet stored; same strict key and fingerprint rules as q0162. Review amendments 2026-10-17: requires the q0160 paging criterion (g) (deep offsets up to 4,000; a 400 at offset > 0 is a capped market-day, not a failure); writes marks/<date>.window.json (expected capture window, earliest capture still available, captures in window, window_start_covered) so captures lost to the 8-day retention are counted; headroom waits return idle_heartbeat. | 2026-10-17 15:35Z autopilot: data-dumps headroom guard 12.5 -> 40 GiB (ops only, not a declared argument): the user grew the host boot volume to 100 GB (root 89 GB, 60 GB free); collector cap 45 GiB, 4 GB free-disk guard unchanged.
